scope: High-count side-less enforcement-derived review points in East Kitsilano between Burrard and Arbutus, north of W 16th
method: July/August 2024 Street View panoramas were panned along each street and local signs were zoomed. No whole block is classified from parked cars or the absence of a visible sign.

findings.observation: Eastward and westward views show parked cars on both sides but no readable parking sign and directional extent.

A no-parking symbol with a small arrow is visible on the east side near W 13th. Its exact directional coverage and end point cannot be reliably placed from this single sign, and it does not classify the opposite west curb or the whole 2900 block.

Intersection no-parking signs are visible ahead near W 10th, but the candidate block has no readable sign establishing both curb faces and sign-arrow endpoints. City meter records over 40 m away are near a different intersection and cannot classify this point.
Eastward and westward views show parked cars, but no readable curb rule or arrow extent on either side.
